attributes.missing_data_policy: preserve_nan; missing hours are never zero
attributes.feature_window: soil moisture offsets [24, 72] h; precipitation [24, 72, 168] h; runoff [24, 72, 168] h; state window 6 h
attributes.wind_direction_convention: Meteorological convention: degrees clockwise from north indicating the direction the wind blows FROM. 0/360 = northerly (from the north), 90 = easterly, 180 = southerly, 270 = westerly. Computed as (270 - degrees(atan2(v10, u10))) mod 360.
